items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Willie Washington, that's Booker's brother. He's back on Gileser Street out collecting insurance from him, you understand? Does he play music? Well he don't

ctx.x: Booker Washington used to play bass. He died. Oh yeah. Yeah, well that was his cousin. And they had another one, what they call, he's living back there kind of off now, Willie Washington, that's Booker's brother. He's back on Gileser Street out collecting insurance from him, you understand? Does he play music? Well he don't, having Joe Bentley and all that bunch used to play with Nat Tolles, you understand? Really? What they wanted to play with? They used to play out of Nat Tolles, Nat Tolles band, headquarters…
Well anyway, who did you hear in Chicago when you were out there? Did you hear any music? Yeah.
